title: UX Writer
description:
Title: UX Writer
Duration: 18 Months with possible extension
Location: Mountain View, CA (Hybrid)
Payrange: $58-$60/hr on W2

UX Writing & Content Design is part of a larger UX team working on experiences that help bring devices and services to the world. We do this by shaping the language and communication with customers who explore, purchase, and enjoy hardware and subscription services.

The role

As a content designer, you'll join a Hardware design team working with a fast paced environment that touches everything from software development, packaging design, as well as the broader Android XR partners.

This is a long term hybrid role on the UX Writing & Content Design team, with engagement through Q4 2027 at minimum. Our team of full-time writers is based in the Bay Area, East Coast and the expectation is for you to collaborate with cross-functional partners based in multiple time zones.


Responsibilities

In this role, you will:

1. Write clear and engaging UI text
We underpin great user experiences with simple, straightforward language rooted in research and user-centered design principles.

For example:
Guiding users through complex journeys
Helping users understand multimodal input methods
Encouraging users to take action

2. Define and design the experience
We look beyond words to shape the product holistically, designing end-to-end user experiences from vision, to execution, to polish.

For example:
Creating voice and tone guidelines
Defining product principles and narratives
Naming features and products

3. Help frame and articulate value
We collaborate to tell the story of a product's value across audiences and use cases, helping align teams on a user-centric narrative.

For example:
Crafting vision and strategy narratives
Shaping product and feature value props
Defining privacy language and concepts

4. Build for the system
We play a key role in scaling product design in the Gemini era, folding patterns into a system and evolving the Android XR ecosystem

For example:
Defining standards and styles
Creating and refining LLM system prompts
Establishing a single source of truth


Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Journalism, Technical Writing, UX, HCI, or equivalent practical experience
5+ years of relevant industry experience, including partnering with Eng, Product, UX and other cross-functional teams to build products
Proven ability to independently drive content projects forward with minimal guidance
Experience in user-focused product writing, including work in hardware, software, digital agencies, or other relevant settings
Experience working alongside other designers in tools like in Figma
Experience defining, training, and evaluating LLMs
Experience with localization and accessibility best practices
Familiarity with user experience research principles and practices and how to use data to provide informed user insights
A portfolio of UX-focused writing samples and style guidelines

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Job Description:
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and evolve key capabilities within the Deposits domain of our Core Banking platform. This role is a senior individual contributor position responsible for shaping product direction, translating business and customer needs into scalable platform capabilities, and delivering measurable outcomes in partnership with engineering. You will work closely with an Engineering Manager (EM) in a dual-track agile model, owning the what and why of the product while collaborating on how and when execution happens.
Product Scope & Impact:
  • Owns one or more end-to-end product areas within the Deposits domain (e.g., account lifecycle, balances, interest, postings, statements, configuration, internal ledger integrations, transactions).
  • Drives multi-quarter product initiatives and roadmap outcomes for their domain.
  • Iterates on existing features and identifies new capabilities or product suites that improve customer experience, operational efficiency, or platform scalability.
  • Creates clarity from ambiguity by defining problem statements, success metrics, and prioritization frameworks.
  • Aligns deposit domain initiatives with adjacent domains and broader Core Banking and Banking Software strategy.

Key Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Discovery:
  • Define and own the product strategy and roadmap for assigned deposit capabilities.
  • Translate business, regulatory, and customer needs into clear product outcomes and initiatives.
  • Make informed trade-offs between speed, quality, scalability, and regulatory requirements.
Delivery & Execution:
  • Own and maintain a prioritized product backlog with clear epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Partner with the Engineering Manager on sprint planning, sequencing, and release planning.
  • Participate actively in Scrum ceremonies and day-to-day team execution.
Stakeholder & Customer Collaboration:
  • Act as the primary product interface for business, operations, compliance, risk, and technology stakeholders.
  • Ensure deposit products meet functional, regulatory, and operational requirements without unnecessary complexity.
  • Communicate product direction clearly and persuasively to diverse audiences.
Technical & Platform Awareness:
  • Apply strong understanding of core banking concepts and architectures (e.g., accounts, postings, interest calculation, batch vs. real-time processing).
  • Drive product decisions that support scalable, resilient, and maintainable platform design.
  • Collaborate with engineering and architecture on build vs. buy vs. deprecate decisions.

Required Experience & Qualifications:
  • 7–12+ years of professional experience, with 5+ years in Product Management roles for complex technology platforms.
  • Mandatory experience working in: Banks, banking technology providers, or fintech companies (B2B or B2C financial services platforms). Experience in US regulated financial environments.
  • Demonstrated experience delivering platform or domain-heavy products (core banking, payments, lending, ledger, financial infrastructure, or regulated platforms).
  • Experience working in agile Scrum teams with close PM–Engineering Manager collaboration.
  • Proven ability to manage ambiguity, define strategy, and deliver incremental value in complex environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Nice to Have (Not Mandatory):
  • Experience with core banking platforms (e.g., Temenos, Thought Machine, Mambu, Finxact, FIServe, FIS, JackHenry or similar).
  • Experience with APIs, microservices architectures, or cloud-native platforms.

title: Senior Product Manager - Digital Banking
description:
Job Description:
Role Overview:
  • We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own and evolve our software product for digital channel capabilities for banking customers, spanning mobile applications and web portals.
  • This role focuses on digital channel capabilities for banks and the underlying platform capabilities that power them—authentication, entitlements, navigation, transactions, personalization, notifications, and integrations with core banking and other downstream services.
  • You will work closely with an Engineering Manager (EM) in a dual-track agile model, owning the what and why of the product while partnering on delivery execution within a dedicated Scrum team. You will work as a team with a second product manager (PM) in the same domain.
Product Scope & Impact:
  • Co-owns one or more digital channel product areas (e.g. mobile banking app, web portal, digital capabilities framework, possibly chatbot capabilities, front-ends and journeys) with a product management team colleague.
  • Drives multi-quarter roadmap outcomes for assigned digital capabilities.
  • Iterates on existing channel features and identifies new digital experiences or platform enhancements that improve customer engagement, conversion, and satisfaction.
  • Creates clarity from ambiguity by translating user needs, analytics, and business goals into clear product priorities.
  • Aligns digital channel initiatives with core banking, payments, security, and data platforms.

Key Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Discovery:
  • Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for assigned digital channel capabilities.
  • Translate customer, business, and regulatory needs into clear problem statements and outcomes.
  • Balance usability, performance, security, and scalability when shaping solutions.
  • Make informed trade-offs in environments with competing priorities and constraints.
Delivery & Execution:
  • Own and maintain a prioritized product backlog, ensuring clarity and readiness for sprint execution.
  • Partner with the Engineering Manager on sprint planning, sequencing, and release coordination.
  • Partner with professional services who are delivering the product to our bank clients
  • Actively participate in Scrum ceremonies and day-to-day product decision-making.
Customer & Stakeholder Collaboration:
  • Act as the primary product interface for stakeholders across digital, marketing, operations, compliance, security, and technology.
  • Incorporate insights from UX research, analytics, and customer feedback into product decisions.
  • Clearly communicate product direction, scope, and rationale to diverse audiences.
Technical & Platform Awareness:
  • Apply strong understanding of digital channel architectures (mobile apps, web portals, APIs, authentication, session management).
  • Drive product decisions that support secure, scalable, and maintainable digital platforms.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to avoid unnecessary complexity and technical debt.

Behavioral Expectations:
Ownership & Agency:
  • Takes strong ownership of product outcomes and proactively removes blockers.
  • Operates independently within scope while seeking guidance on high-judgment or cross-domain decisions.
Communication:
  • Distills complex technical and UX topics into clear, actionable product requirements and narratives.
  • Produces high-quality written and verbal communication tailored to stakeholder needs.
Leadership & Influence:
  • Builds trusted relationships with engineering, design, and business partners.
  • Resolves most conflicts constructively and independently.
  • Influences decisions through data, customer insight, and structured reasoning rather than authority.
Operational Excellence:
  • Co-leads execution from discovery through delivery and go-live.
  • Uses analytics, experimentation, and qualitative insights to inform prioritization.
  • Continuously improves product quality, delivery predictability, and team effectiveness.

Required Qualifications:
  • 7–12+ years of professional experience, with 5+ years in Product Management roles.
  • Mandatory experience working in digital banking or financial services technology, such as:
  • Banks (digital banking, channels, or e-banking teams), or
  • Digital banking platform vendors, digital engagement providers, or fintechs focused on customer-facing solutions (e.g., Backbase, Temenos, Alkami, Apiture).
  • Experience with digital banking or engagement platforms (e.g. mobile banking SDKs, channel orchestration layers, digital onboarding solutions).
  • Exposure to API-first or microservices-based architectures.
  • Proven experience delivering mobile and/or web-based products used at scale by end customers.
  • Strong experience working in agile Scrum teams with close PM–Engineering Manager collaboration.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, define product direction, and deliver incremental customer value.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Nice to Have (Not Mandatory):
  • Familiarity with security, authentication, and entitlements in regulated environments.
  • Experience with analytics, experimentation, or personalization in digital products.
  • Spanish language proficiency is a plus, not mandatory.

title: Operations Data Analyst, Expert
description:
**SUBMIT LOCAL CANDIDATES ONLY in *** service territory** The role is hybrid, up to 2 days per week onsite at Oakland General Office.

*Client laptop will be provided once available. A vendor-issued laptop would be acceptable to access the *** network via VPN/Citrix until *** issues one.. No other equipment will be provided and additional equipment needed is the responsibility of supplier. Calls to be made via MS Teams.*

TOP THINGS LOOKING FOR:
Technical skills:
Data analytics ( Python, excel, conduct data queries as needed)
Power BI (advanced skills, ability to create executive boards AND day to day dashboards for business analytics)
SAP
Microsoft, excel and power query as needed
Soft skills:
Problem solving mentality
Willingness to learn ( Copperleaf, Foundry, GIS, and other platforms)
Impeccable organization skills
Agility
Impeccable communication skills


Position Summary

The Data Analyst is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, actionable insights that drive operational and strategic decision-making. This role requires an exceptional communicator who can clearly explain data, assumptions, and insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders alike. The ideal candidate is highly proficient in Power BI for reporting and visualization and Foundry for advanced analytics and data modeling, and is comfortable working across multiple enterprise systems and teams.

Responsibilities:

Data Analysis & Insights
• Analyze business data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities for operational and strategic improvements
• Demonstrate broad expertise in data processing and analysis, applying analytical techniques to a wide range of business questions
• Respond to ad hoc and recurring data requests with accuracy, clarity, and timeliness

Data Management & Integration
• Collect, clean, validate, and integrate data from multiple sources to ensure accuracy and consistency
• Extract and analyze data from SAP to support planning, forecasting, and decision-making
• Manage data extraction and transfer from databases to support operational analysis across teams
• Create automated data routines and processes to ensure efficient, repeatable reporting and data delivery

Reporting, Visualization & Tools
• Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Power BI to clearly communicate insights and performance metrics
• Utilize Foundry for advanced analytics, data modeling, and analytical workflows ( knowledge of Foundry is preferred, not a requirement)
• Apply GIS tools for spatial data analysis and mapping to support location-based decision-making
• Leverage Copperleaf for asset investment planning, lifecycle cost analysis, and value-based decision support ( knowledge of Copperleaf is preferred, not a requirement)

Communication & Collaboration (Core Requirement)
• Clearly communicate analytical findings, assumptions, and recommendations to diverse audiences
• Translate complex data into concise, compelling narratives that support informed decision-making
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business needs, identify challenges, and deliver data-driven solutions
• Act as a trusted partner to stakeholders by helping shape analytical questions and clarify insights

Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Business, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
• Demonstrated experience building and maintaining dashboards in Power BI
• Strong SQL skills and experience working with structured datasets
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to explain complex data clearly
• Strong ability to interpret data, identify trends, and generate actionable insights
• Ability to clearly communicate complex data findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Experience working in cross-functional teams and translating business needs into data-driven solutions.


Desired Qualifications:
- Hands-on experience using Foundry for data analysis, data modeling, or workflows
- Experience with Copperleaf

title: Senior Quality Supplier Engineer (Service)
description:
Actual Job Title: Service Supplier Development Engineer

*** contractor through end of year (not FTE role)
  • Supporting the global supply chain with various time zones
  • Ability to travel internationally
  • Focus on the service part of the PPAP
  • Working hours: 8 hours daily can be outside working hours
  • This role will not be approved for overtime

Role Summary:
You will work alongside cross-functional teams to drive *** quality requirements and manage our contract manufacturers' quality performance, ensuring seamless scaling of production. Your contributions will directly impact the performance and quality of *** service parts, ensuring successful launches for new programs as well as proper management on current ones. This role reports through the Service Supplier Quality Engineering Team.

Responsibilities:
  • Engage with suppliers for industrialisation and readiness for multiple automotive components.
  • Support supplier selection and capability assessment for various projects, ensuring alignment with program timelines and quality expectations.
  • Drive APQP discipline and enforce PPAP requirements, ensuring suppliers meet dimensional, material, and performance validation before production approval.
  • Track industrialisation project KPIs, internally and externally to assess supplier readiness.
  • Evaluate and validate supplier manufacturing processes by leading process audits, PFMEA reviews, control plan validation, and equipment capability/Run@rate assessments.
  • Optimize supplier manufacturing scalability, ensuring production lines are capable of meeting increasing volume and quality expectations during ramp-up phases.
  • Monitor supplier industrialisation performance through KPIs such as on-time PPAP submission, process capability indices (Cpk/Ppk), defect rates (PPM), issue closure rate*** and supplier corrective action effectiveness.
  • Facilitate problem resolution using structured methodologies (focused problem solving) to address defects, process deviations, and launch roadblocks proactively.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, quality, and supply chain teams to drive VA/VE cost optimisation, ensuring seamless design implementation into supplier manufacturing processes and technology while maintaining quality and performance standards

Up to 50% travel requirement

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, or other related field
  • Strong Knowledge of Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), Failure Mode and Effect Analysis (FMEA), Corrective and Preventative Actions (CAPA) development, Lean manufacturing, Traceability requirements
  • Technical expertise in automotive components design and manufacturing, including knowledge of safety and test requirements and the appearance approval process.
  • Knowledge of Geometric Design and Tolerancing (GD&T) and datum structures.
  • Experience in Extrusion and fabrication commodities.
  • VDA 6.3 credentials and understanding preferred.
  • In-depth knowledge of IATF16949:2016 and understanding of ISO14001. ISO9001 is also a preferred knowledge set.
  • Ability to stand, sit, or walk for 8-10 hours per day.
  • Required to communicate using phone and/or e-mail.
  • Ability to view, read, and interpret documents.
  • Ability to perform all duties in an office environment that may contain ambient noise and temperature fluctuations
